SF Opera hosts two-day costume sale in Burlingame

Sale held Oct. 17–18

By Allyson Aleksey · October 7, 2026 · 1 min read

San Francisco Opera hosts a costume collection sale in Burlingame October 17 and 18, offering shoppers the chance to purchase theatrical garments and accessories from decades of productions at the War Memorial Opera House.

The two-day sale will take place at the company’s Scene Shop in Burlingame, with items ranging from Victorian dresses and Edwardian ensembles to 1920s fashions, military uniforms, capes and fantasy costumes.

The collection includes pieces from productions such as Luisa Miller, Un Ballo in Maschera, Idomeneo, Fidelio and Don Giovanni. Prices will range from $5 to $525, with premium items priced higher. Stage props and other opera merchandise will also be available.

The sale offers opportunities for collectors, performers and others seeking distinctive clothing for Halloween, Renaissance fairs, theatrical productions and masquerades.

San Francisco Opera periodically holds costume sales to make room for new productions. Proceeds from admission fees and sales will support the company.

The public sale will run from 9:30 a.m. to 6:30 p.m. both days, with the last entry at 4:30 p.m. Timed-entry tickets are required and include two hours of shopping. Admission ranges from $5 to $25, depending on the day and time.
